src.title: These snacks have barely any calories

recipes.title: Barely-Any-Calorie Pre-Dinner Snacks

items.i: red wine vinegar (or balsamic / apple cider)
quick spray of avocado or olive oil

steps: Dip carrot sticks in hot mustard.
Keep dill pickle spears in the fridge for a quick salty hit.
Chop the cucumber into a bowl, add a splash of vinegar, salt and pepper, tear in some basil and dust with a teaspoon of nutritional yeast.
Spread the broccolini on a lined tray, give it a quick spray of oil, salt it and sprinkle with nutritional yeast. Roast at about 220 °C (425 °F) for 12–15 minutes until crispy at the tips.
recipes.notes: Four low-calorie snacks to take the edge off before dinner. The video doesn't give amounts, oven settings or macros — those are estimates (macros per serving of the cucumber bowl plus half the broccolini). Go easy on the oil.
